scope: Root game current achievement/game definitions; static source inventory, not all-game runtime attainability certification. Prototype content handled separately.

achievement_unlock.description: Check on save; exceptions leave achievement locked; no direct coin or item payout.

play_entry.description: Not sleeping/egg/dead/transforming/in-game. Ordinary energy>=10 and gamepass cooldown complete; gamepass1 substitutes auto result.

ordinary_result.score: Raw score clamped0–100; great>=70, success30–69, failure<30; ranks S90 A75 B55 C35 D0.
ordinary_result.coins: 60 great /30 success /0 failure; star equipment triples base.
ordinary_result.growth: great +14 growth -8 decline; success +7 growth -3 decline; failure +8 decline +2 death meter.
ordinary_result.other: Happiness +round(5+score/100*20); energy environment-scaled cost12 min1; transform meter+25 (perk60 x1.2). Daily designated game score>=30 grants c_coin2 once/day. Otherwise S gives2min growth boost (10min cap),30% random sticker chance. Pending companion recruitment uses separate raw score threshold.

findings.description: Master spec explicitly marks old counts (75 achievements, 168 forms, seasonal games) historical; runtime tables are current authority.

Official IDs retain old thresholds; use exact condition, not numeric ID suffix. Examples minigame-50 requires30; games-complete-100 uses current pool length; record-rank-s-15 requires10; feed-100 requires30.
All10 region and4 seasonal games always available; location/season affect weighting, not exclusivity. games.js comments near line68 and seasonal definitions are stale.
Equipped gamepass1 returns before actionCounts.play, environment-play and game record increment. Unequip it to earn actual-play and rank achievements.
Old achievement preamble says dex-complete excluded, but current endingProgress includes all ACHIEVEMENTS.
downhill-mountain now names やまの岩場のぼり and uses makeRockClimbGame. Preserve official save ID.
Five goal tiers but four ENDING_CELEBRATIONS entries; PERFECT tier4 has no particle configuration. Explicit source-known gap, not an unlock blocker.
